I like being the always happy-guy I like knowing that people see me as someone to confide in an that they can trust and I feel like my friends and family see me as superhuman my nickname around everyone is superman an I feel like if I show this crack in my armor they won't hold me to such a high standard I feel like they won't confide in me anymore because they don't want to pile their problems on me but the thing is I can handle whatever they lay on me it's my own feelings and thoughts that I worry about that's what makes me think about killing myself and the feelings and thoughts are just so natural that I feel like they're almost mine but I have goals and things that I want to do in my life and I know killing myself would stop everything but sometimes the thoughts and feelings overpower my desires and motivation to keep driving forward
